item.title: When AI Speed Stalls: Boards Must Govern Platform Adoption
item.description: AI tools are helping teams draft code faster, but delivery still bogs down in bottlenecks, side paths and manual work. Boards need to oversee platform adoption—not just AI uptake—so the organization’s standard route to production becomes fast, safe and widely used.
